summary: V38 Fatture module testing. Backend: 5/6 tests passed (analysis_params passthrough OK, cancel endpoint OK 200/400/404, comparison error paths OK). CRITICAL BUG PERSISTS: single LLM call for the new 6-section COMPARISON_PROMPT exceeds the ~60s ingress timeout, so /bills/comparison still returns 502 for real requests. The asyncio.gather 'parallel' fix only helps SUM-of-latencies when >1 pair exists; it does NOT reduce single-call latency. Frontend: Fatture tab shows the required distinctive orange styling (dot rgb(234,88,12) + faint tint rgba(234,88,12,0.06)) and the new bills-report-btn / bills-compare-btn testIDs are present. Click on bills-compare-btn triggered no popup-blocked warning and no new tab was opened. Cancel-header / delete-header / config modal could not be exercised because the test contact has no analyzed bills and DocumentPicker cannot be triggered headlessly.

critical.issue: Still returns HTTP 502 (Bad Gateway from ingress at ~60.1s) when a valid bill+offer pair exists. Seeded a status=done luce bill + status=done luce offer via DB, called endpoint → 502 after 60.1s. Backend logs show LiteLLM call to claude-sonnet-5 started but did not complete before the ingress 60s timeout. The V38 fix (asyncio.gather in _safe_compare) only reduces total time for MULTIPLE pairs; it does NOT reduce a single LLM call's latency, and the new 6-section COMPARISON_PROMPT is much larger than the previous prompt, so a single Claude Sonnet 5 completion regularly exceeds 60s. Recommendation: (a) split the prompt into 2-3 smaller LLM calls per pair that can also run via gather (e.g. one for numeric sections, one for narrative sections), (b) reduce max output tokens / trim COMPARISON_PROMPT, (c) enable streaming, or (d) return a fast '202 accepted' + poll pattern so the client stays under 60s while the LLM runs in background.

integration_issues.issue: bills-compare-btn is visible and tappable but currently disabled for the test user (no analyzed bills). Could not verify the iframe.print() flow end-to-end because we could not seed a fully analyzed bill+offer pair through the UI. Backend-side the same request returns 502, so even with data the visual comparison report cannot render today.

rca_of_issue: CRITICAL 502 on /bills/comparison — RCA: the V38 change extended COMPARISON_PROMPT with 6 new nested sections (impronta_energetica, dettaglio_fasce, analisi_contratto_attuale, calcolo_risparmio, matrice_confronto, executive_summary) which dramatically increases the LLM's output size and generation time. Claude Sonnet 5 now takes >60s to complete a single comparison, and the Kubernetes ingress cuts the HTTP connection at ~60s → 502 Bad Gateway. The V38 attempt to fix this by moving the 3 LLM calls to asyncio.gather is correct but only addresses the multi-pair case (parallel gather turns sum→max). For a single pair (or the max of 3 parallel pairs), latency is still that of one LLM call, which exceeds the ingress limit. Repro: 1) POST /auth/login as test@dalpastro.it. 2) Seed one done luce bill + one done luce offer for this user (either via UI upload + wait for analysis, or via the direct DB insert in test_v38_bills_v38.py). 3) GET /api/contacts/{cid}/bills/comparison → 502 after 60.1s. Mitigation ideas: split the prompt, trim it, or move to a 202+poll pattern.
